# Nell Harcourt & Thora

- [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) — Friend of — [Thora](../character/thora.md) — landlady and companion · since v3  <sub>[v3 ch.Cressida P2](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0002), [v3 ch.Last P24](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0024), [v3 ch.Last P45](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0045)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) arrives at [Coombe Road](../codex/places.md#coombe-road) station, where she is picked up by Mrs. Amelia [Skinner](../character/skinner.md), who is temporarily driving the mail carriage for her new husband, [Thomas](../character/thomas-sowerby.md). During the drive to [Thora](../character/thora.md) Sweet's home, Mrs. [Skinner](../character/skinner.md) entertains [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) with stories about her suitors and marriage choices before dropping her off at [Wayside](../codex/places.md#wayside).
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXX Mrs. Skinner’s Romance

_Sources: [v3 ch.Romance P0](../source/v03-c30.md#nw-v03-c30-p0000), [v3 ch.Romance P3](../source/v03-c30.md#nw-v03-c30-p0003), [v3 ch.Romance P5](../source/v03-c30.md#nw-v03-c30-p0005), [v3 ch.Romance P15](../source/v03-c30.md#nw-v03-c30-p0015)_

> In a letter to [Cressy Lindsay](../character/cressy-lindsay.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) describes settling into her new lodgings at [Wayside](../codex/places.md#wayside) with [Thora](../character/thora.md) Sweet in [Coombe Road](../codex/places.md#coombe-road). She details the house, Thora's quirks, and the local atmosphere, while reflecting on past romances she has witnessed or facilitated.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXXI Nell to Cressida

_Sources: [v3 ch.Cressida P0](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0000), [v3 ch.Cressida P1](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0001), [v3 ch.Cressida P5](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0005), [v3 ch.Cressida P9](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0009)_

> [Thora](../character/thora.md) breaks down to [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) about turning forty without [John Fairlie](../character/john-fairlie.md) ever proposing despite twenty years of courting. [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) convinces [Thora](../character/thora.md) to stand up to him, but when [Thora](../character/thora.md) coldly rejects John after prayer meeting, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) immediately regrets it and rushes to bring John back.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXXIII “He Just Kept Coming and Coming”

_Sources: [v3 ch.Coming” P0](../source/v03-c33.md#nw-v03-c33-p0000), [v3 ch.Coming” P8](../source/v03-c33.md#nw-v03-c33-p0008), [v3 ch.Coming” P23](../source/v03-c33.md#nw-v03-c33-p0023), [v3 ch.Coming” P27](../source/v03-c33.md#nw-v03-c33-p0027)_

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) receives an unexpected and awkward marriage proposal from her neighbor [Sam](../character/sam.md), which she rejects and later laughs about with [Thora](../character/thora.md). [Hector](../character/hector.md) Ward arrives at [Wayside](../codex/places.md#wayside) to inform [Thora](../character/thora.md) that John Fairlie's mother is dying, and [Thora](../character/thora.md) returns later to report her death. Following the funeral, [John Fairlie](../character/john-fairlie.md) finally proposes to [Thora](../character/thora.md) and explains that his late mother had secretly forced him to vow not to marry during her lifetime, after which [Thora](../character/thora.md) agrees to marry him.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXXIV John Fairlie Speaks at Last

_Sources: [v3 ch.Last P12](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0012), [v3 ch.Last P25](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0025), [v3 ch.Last P36](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0036), [v3 ch.Last P40](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0040)_
